technical_and_design_decisions: Implement each user story as a separate Spring Cloud Stream sink or processor module.
For Kinesis sink, use AWS SDK for Java and integrate with Spring Cloud Stream's binder abstraction.
Port existing XD modules (Log, field-value-counter, aggregate-counter, gauge, rich-gauge) by adapting their code to the s-c-s programming model.
For Flink processor, leverage Spring Cloud Stream's Flink support (if available) or build a custom Spring Cloud Stream application that wraps a Flink job.
For job DSL, design a simple domain-specific language parser (e.g., ANTLR) to define workflows and integrate with Spring Cloud Data Flow.
All modules will be built as Maven/Gradle subprojects under a common parent POM for consistent dependency management.
assumptions: s-c-s refers to Spring Cloud Stream.
XD refers to Spring XD, and the existing source code is available for reference.
The developer is proficient in Java 17+, Spring Framework 6.0+, Spring Cloud Stream, AWS SDK, Apache Flink, and DSL parsing.
Each module will include unit tests, integration tests (with mock services where appropriate), and basic documentation (README, usage examples).
Effort estimates include design, coding, testing, documentation, and code review for each activity.
The Flink processor and job DSL modules are new developments; porting from XD requires understanding existing code but is relatively straightforward.
No significant cross-module dependencies; integration testing will validate that all modules work together in a single build.

activities.activity_description: Develop a Spring Cloud Stream sink module that writes data to Amazon Kinesis. Includes AWS SDK integration, configuration properties, and testing with Localstack or actual AWS.

activities.activity_name: Port Log sink module from XD
activities.activity_description: Adapt the Spring XD Log sink to work as a Spring Cloud Stream sink module. Involves converting XD-specific code to use s-c-s abstractions and writing unit/integration tests.

activities.activity_name: Port field-value-counter sink module from XD
activities.activity_description: Port the field-value-counter module from Spring XD to Spring Cloud Stream. Implement as a sink that counts distinct field values, with tests.

activities.activity_name: Port aggregate-counter sink module from XD
activities.activity_description: Port the aggregate-counter module from Spring XD to Spring Cloud Stream. Implements a sink that aggregates counters, with tests.

activities.activity_name: Port gauge sink module from XD
activities.activity_description: Port the gauge module from Spring XD to Spring Cloud Stream. Implements a sink that records gauge values, with tests.

activities.activity_name: Port rich-gauge sink module from XD
activities.activity_description: Port the rich-gauge module from Spring XD to Spring Cloud Stream. Implements a more detailed gauge sink, with tests.
Develop a Spring Cloud Stream processor that uses Apache Flink for streaming computations. Includes Flink job setup, integration with s-c-s, and testing with embedded Flink.
Design and implement a domain-specific language for defining job workflows and job orchestration. This involves creating a parser, data model, and integration with Spring Cloud Data Flow.
Run comprehensive integration tests across all new modules, ensure build consistency, fix any cross-module issues, and prepare release artifacts (e.g., updated POMs, documentation).
